name: jimbo-ui
description: jimbo.ui, Ryan's shared brand and UI system and the binding rules his apps follow: shadcn/ui components themed from one token mapping, a theme engine with two to four colours and their shades, everyday, flag and holiday templates, a flat look with a circle motif, UI kit, app shell and patterns, with workflows to start apps on it, update and audit them, amend it by PR, and release changes.
